feasibility_gate.calculation: Resource-constrained residual schedule uses the same actor reservations, output prerequisites and measured CI/provider occupancy. Earliest_complete=max(last_required_build_and_consumer_finish, last_required_CI_finish, last_required_live_proof_finish, last_independent_review_and_correction_finish)+final_receipt_reserve. Receipt reserve is the two planned minutes 118-120, not a measured claim. Unknown required input yields UNKNOWN, never zero.
feasibility_gate.continue_rule: If unsupported/late: retain every capability/check, publish owners and revised resource-constrained ETA, use newly free actors only on disjoint paths/proofs via lease, preserve independence and continue. T120 may report MISSED but must not call partial product DONE or silently stop.
feasibility_gate.cannot_claim: No claim that 120 is feasible merely because sum of nominal windows is<=120; no invented duration for full suite, generated Atlas, model latency or runner supply.
